summary: packages/core/src/index.ts does not re-export domain/lean-video.ts, so meeting-bot imports it by deep path '@lkb/core/src/domain/lean-video.js' (lane could not edit core). Works under tsx and tsc (nodenext) but bypasses the package entry point.
fix_direction: add `export * from "./domain/lean-video.js";` to packages/core/src/index.ts, then switch the two imports (capture/record-finalize.ts, lean-video-obs.ts, obs-windows.ts type import) to '@lkb/core'.

summary: runRecord's OBS branch (record-commands.ts, `leanVideo: {}`) is not behaviour-tested: it needs a real OBSWebSocket and OBS_WS_PASSWORD. Only a source-text pin guards it. Also unverified on live OBS: SimpleOutput VBitrate/ABitrate take effect only if the profile uses Simple output mode and recording quality 'Same as stream'; Advanced mode or a separate recording encoder would ignore them, and the size would then be flagged over target by the finalize alert.
fix_direction: the 60-minute live run (T-035 exit criterion) confirms or refutes; if ignored, set RecQuality/Advanced-output keys in toObsRequests (core).

summary: applyLeanVideoToObs rewrites the operator's OBS profile and never restores it. SetVideoSettings (canvas base/output size, fps) and SetProfileParameter SimpleOutput VBitrate/ABitrate persist in the OBS profile (basic.ini) after the bot's recording; nothing in lean-video-obs.ts, obs-windows.ts stop/launch or the manifest reads the previous values or puts them back, and the permanence is not documented. With leanVideo:{} ON for every `lkb record`, every later manual OBS use inherits 1280x720 @5 fps / 500 kbps.
fix_direction: read GetVideoSettings and GetProfileParameter for the same keys before applying, restore them in stop()/failure paths (like the muted-input restore), or document the profile as bot-owned; add a behaviour test with a fake client that asserts the restore calls.
